# RFC 8785 test vectors

The `input` and `output` files are copied from the reference implementation's
test data at
https://github.com/cyberphone/json-canonicalization/tree/57a0ce2678a7/testdata
(Copyright 2018 Anders Rundgren, Apache License 2.0). Each file in `input`
must canonicalize to the file of the same name in `output`.
